description: Byte-exact copies of PR #66 source, vendored read-only so Model 1 can execute PR #66 ACTUAL validators against Model 1 golden FetchJobs. Not a re-implementation and not a simplified duplicate.
what_it_proves: How PR #66 own criteria-identity and legacy-compatibility logic judges a FetchJob produced by main Stage 0-4 code.
what_it_does_not_prove: It does not prove PR #66 end-to-end HTTP behaviour, its database queries, or that PR #66 will merge in this form.
checksum_note: sha256 is taken over LF-normalized UTF-8 content, so the check survives git core.autocrlf on Windows checkouts.
